conclusion: Both tableless lowered EH references are surviving typed IL dynamic-initialization references and may be serialized as exact metadata links. They are not lowering-private destructible or stack init-position descriptors.

evidence.fact: Full portable mode forces tables, but partial mode supports no tables and forces lifetime retention.
Cleanup/unreachable-state cleanup_ptr denotes destruction at which to start cleanup; initialization_completed.dynamic_init denotes completed initialization.
State operation stores actual cleanup_state dynamic-init pointer directly in tableless mode.
Completion operation stores actual dip pointer after construction completion; never repeat its initialization on traversal.
Dynamic initialization allocated in current IL memory region by alloc_cil_of_type.
End-of-lowering cleanup frees and clears destructible_entity_descr, preserves dip/lifetime/destruction lists when retention active. init_destination may be stack-only and is not exported.
Resident IL configuration frees front-end-only memory region, not retained IL regions.
Stock IL walker recognizes both references as a_dynamic_init_ptr / iek_dynamic_init.
Debug partial-EH cases recognize pointer representation; not an emitted portable-EH recipe.
Tableless prologue supplement retains routine association and has no region/array table fields.

adapter_notes: Broaden common lowered-EH handler from tables-only guard without enabling full portable lowering.
Use existing lowered_eh_operation.initialization_id as kind-discriminated exact pointer link; do not duplicate payload.
State-number and initial/null-state numeric values are unavailable in pointer mode; nullable typed properties instead of invented zero/index.
Serialize pointer targets via existing Initialization adapter as metadata and preserve actual destructor/lifetime/master/current target links.

Retained references do not justify reconstructing freed lowering-private storage conditions or claiming table-decoded EH action parity. Primary table-backed profile remains executable cleanup/storage authority.
Genuine simple/conditional/array/nested-try fixtures should demonstrate surviving identity links after wrapup; no corruption tests.
